items.title: Expressive Painterly Realistic Hybrid Portrait
items.prompt: Using the attached object, recreate it as identically as possible. Create a sophisticated hybrid portrait blending expressive painterly realism with polished cinematic digital illustration. Preserve the exact facial structure, expression, pose, hairstyle, clothing, proportions, and overall composition. Use visible, confident brushstrokes, subtle dry-brush textures, delicate sketch lines, soft glazing, natural pigment variation, and handcrafted imperfections—avoid an overly smooth or airbrushed look. Use warm peach, coral, terracotta, amber, and soft-pink skin tones with rich shadows in mauve, plum, charcoal, espresso, and slate. Add realistic luminous highlights to the forehead, nose, cheekbones, and lips. Make the eyes highly expressive and cinematic, with detailed irises, realistic reflections, fine lashes, and controlled catchlights. Keep facial anatomy convincing, elegant, and mature. Hair and clothing should have fluid painterly strokes, natural folds, selective sharp details, and loose expressive edges. Use dramatic directional cinematic lighting, subtle rim light, atmospheric shadows, and soft background blending. Overall style: premium contemporary concept art combining traditional hand-painted texture, impressionistic realism, elegant linework, cinematic polish, and refined character illustration. Minimal atmospheric background, sophisticated warm-neutral palette, strong focus on the face and gaze. Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical.
